subject: CAIQ sector sampling + log-harvest playbook and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@trustguard.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ sector sampling + log-harvest playbook and delivery timeline

Maya / Nimbus audits team —

Thanks again for the heads up on the CAIQ scope. To keep this tidy for the assessment window, we propose splitting the CAIQ into three "sectors" (networking & infra, identity & access, runtime/logging) and delivering a focused evidence bundle per sector. This will let us provide targeted log samples and tailored narratives rather than a monolithic package.

High-level plan (attached as MA_plan_v1.xlsx):
- Sector A (networking & infra): index + config snapshots + flow logs (3 days)
- Sector B (identity & access): IAM policies, rotation proof, MFA attestations (2 days)
- Sector C (runtime & logging): sample traces, ingestion pipeline diagram, retention proofs (4 days)

Immediate asks:
1) Maya — can you confirm which control families you want prioritized (e.g., CC6.1 / EN1-like)? If you provide a short priority list, we'll sequence deliveries.
2) Nimbus — please confirm whether the audit window can accept 48-hour rolling evidence drops or requires a single handoff.

I've attached a simple sector index (CAIQ_sectorized_index.csv) and a draft log-extraction playbook (log_extraction_playbook.pdf) to make the harvest repeatable for your team.

Kimberly / Naomi: can you own the log extraction for Sector C and the IAM snapshots for Sector B? I'll coordinate packaging and the Drive folder.

Thanks —
Diego
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ_sectorized_index.csv (csv), MA_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), log_extraction_playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Maya Patel <maya@trustguard.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audit@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sector sampling + log-harvest playbook and delivery timeline

Diego — thanks for the clear split. Quick answers:
- Priority controls: runtime/logging family first (we need CC7-like controls for the patient telemetry ingestion), then identity, then networking.
- Handoff: Nimbus prefers daily drops into a shared Drive folder (they have a live intake process).

Two clarifying items:
1) For log samples, do you plan to scrub PII at source or provide redaction guidelines for us to run?
2) Are you able to include a small sample of request-level traces (10–20 requests) with full headers masked?

If you can confirm those, we'll lock the intake window and set expectations internally.

— Maya
Senior Assurance Consultant
TrustGuard Consultancy

(External — not Redwood staff)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@trustguard.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sector sampling + log-harvest playbook and delivery timeline

Maya — good questions. Short answers: we plan to perform in-line redaction for any logs that include customer-identifiable fields (PII) and provide a redaction checklist in the Drive folder. For request-level traces we can provide 15 masked request traces (headers and bodies redacted to tokenized placeholders).

Plan updates:
- We'll push Sector C (runtime/logging) artifacts first: sample traces (15 masked), ingestion pipeline diagram, retention policy proof, and extracted ingestion logs (30-minute windows x 3 days). See log_extraction_playbook.pdf for extraction steps.
- Delivery cadence: daily drops starting Wed 2028-07-11 to the Drive link below.

Kimberly / Naomi — please confirm you can run the extraction on Wed morning and drop the first batch by 14:00 PDT. I'll make the Drive folder and send access.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cCAIQ-samples
HubSpot ticket: HS-987654 (linked to Nimbus Health account)

Diego

On Mon, Jul 9, 2028 at 09:00 AM Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Maya / Nimbus audits team —
> 
> Thanks again for the heads up on the CAIQ scope...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@trustguard.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sector sampling + log-harvest playbook and delivery timeline

Diego / all — I can take Sector C extraction. Notes and constraints:
- I'll run the extraction from the staging cluster to avoid performance impact. We will redact IPs and any keys before export.
- Extraction steps attached: log_extraction_playbook.pdf (recommended fields, redaction scripts, sample grep commands).
- I expect the first batch (3 x 30-minute windows) ready by Wed 14:00 PDT. If Nimbus requests encryption at rest for the drive drop, let me know; we can upload an encrypted archive and share a separate key exchange.

Action items assigned:
- Kimberly: perform log extraction and create sample trace artifacts (due 2028-07-11 14:00 PDT)
- Naomi: collect IAM policy snapshots and rotation logs for Sector B (due 2028-07-12 17:00 PDT)
- Diego: create Drive folder and verify HubSpot linkage

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: log_extraction_playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

All — first drop complete. Quick status:
- Sector C first batch uploaded to Drive (see link). Files: runtime_traces_masked.jsonl (15 traces), ingestion_logs_20280710_slice1.gz (redacted), pipeline_diagram_v2.png
- IAM snapshots: pulled and staged; rotation logs attached in HS ticket as an export.
- I added a short control narrative for CC7.x explaining where traces map to CAIQ control statements; see CAIQ_sectorized_index.csv.

Next steps:
- Kimberly will confirm the extraction checksum and encryption (if Nimbus requests).
- Diego, please confirm Nimbus received the drop and whether the intake system accepted the format.

Naomi Feldman
Security Controls Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded to Drive: runtime_traces_masked.jsonl (jsonl), ingestion_logs_20280710_slice1.gz (gz)
